video_title: Your Brain Isn't Lazy—Your Goals Might Be the Problem
video_description: An original, research-informed five-minute story about Milo, who mistakes borrowed ambitions for personal failure. Ada helps him question a wall of impossible goals, choose one meaningful project and build a specific first step. Warm, tactile 2.5D visual metaphors: a goal wall, a backpack of expectations, a rope tied to a mountain, notifications, a tiny staircase and a forgiving progress calendar. Empathetic, provocative, never diagnostic; distinguish poor goal fit from time, health and material constraints. End with one imperfect page, not a miraculous life transformation.
